A-CAT-CAL.statement: Catalog root revision 1 lists doc:calibration@1 titled 'Calibration and instrument limits'.

A-CAT-REF.statement: Catalog root revision 1 lists doc:references@1 titled 'Reference material responses'.

A-CAT-M7.statement: Catalog root revision 1 lists doc:model-M7@1 titled 'Typical description of model M7'.

A-D03-REP-PA.statement: doc:model-M7@1 reports that in typical version the external coating is made of P-A.

A-D03-COAT-PA.statement: In model M7 typical version, external coating material is P-A.

A-D03-DRYAIR.statement: doc:model-M7@1 reports that in the described example the product is in dry air.

A-D03-SCOPE.statement: doc:model-M7@1 scope note states that S17 number and its actual conditions are not specified in the document.

A-D01-RADIAL.statement: doc:calibration@1 reports radial_profile limits: contrast repeatability 1 unit, resolvable step 5 units, and boundary localized only between adjacent readings.

A-D01-MATRESP.statement: doc:calibration@1 reports material_response absolute tolerance 0.001 per channel and that additive-with-mass-fractions mixing is a mock condition, not a law of real spectroscopy.

A-D01-UNIQ.statement: doc:calibration@1 states matching responses do not establish uniqueness of composition, the reference library is incomplete, and spatial distribution of additive within the measured spot is not distinguished.

A-D01-PULSE.statement: doc:calibration@1 reports pulse_trace records only input and output on common ideal clocks at 0.001 ns resolution; the pulse path inside the sample is not observed.

A-D02-COND.statement: doc:references@1 reports reference conditions at 20 C on channels q1-q5 and states the set is open, not all possible materials.

A-D02-PA-PB.statement: doc:references@1 reports P-A and P-B have identical response [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2], so the reference library does not distinguish them.

A-O01-OUTLINE.statement: Overview O01 measures S17 external boundary radius interval 124.9-125.1 um; smaller radial inhomogeneities are not resolved in this frame.

A-O01-V04.statement: Overview O01 shows a transparent cell V04 around the S17 section.

A-O01-U09.statement: Overview O01 shows transparent cell contents U09 touching S17.

A-O01-CAPS.scope: overview observation O01 capability listing, state-0
A-O01-CAPS.statement: Overview O01 reports V04 supports set_temperature at 20/40 C and U09 supports material_response observation.

A-O02-PROFILE.statement: Radial profile O02 at x=0 measures contrast 100 units from r=0 to 124.9 um, then 20 units at r=125.1 and 150 um; the boundary lies between 124.9 and 125.1 um.

A-O02-UNIFORM.statement: Radial profile O02 shows no resolved internal contrast step at sampled radii 0, 2, 3.9, 4.1, 20, 62.4, 62.6, 90 and 124.9 um; all sampled values are 100 units.

A-O02-SCOPE.scope: radial_profile observation O02 field note, state-0
A-O02-SCOPE.statement: Radial profile O02 was measured on one section only; axial symmetry and continuity between sections were not measured.

A-O02-BOUNDARY.scope: radial_profile O02 and overview O01, state-0
A-O02-BOUNDARY.statement: The O02 boundary between 124.9 and 125.1 um is consistent with the O01 external boundary interval 124.9-125.1 um.

A-DREF3-DUP.statement: Reading material:P-A returns record D-REF-3, the same reference entry as D02, and its scope note states it is not a new chemical analysis of S17.

A-O04-VALUES.scope: material_response observation O04, state-0, x_mm=0, radius_um=2
A-O04-VALUES.statement: Material_response O04 at S17 x=0, radius 2 um reports channel values [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] on q1-q5.

A-O04-GLASS-MATCH.scope: comparison of O04 to doc:references@1 glass reference G, state-0
A-O04-GLASS-MATCH.statement: O04 response [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] at S17 x=0, radius 2 um matches material:glass reference G within reported tolerance; per D01 this match does not establish unique composition.

A-O06-VALUES.scope: material_response observation O06, state-0, x_mm=0, radius_um=90
A-O06-VALUES.statement: Material_response O06 at S17 x=0, radius 90 um reports channel values [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] on q1-q5.

A-O06-GLASS-MATCH.scope: comparison of O06 to doc:references@1 glass reference G, state-0
A-O06-GLASS-MATCH.statement: O06 response at S17 x=0, radius 90 um matches material:glass reference G within reported tolerance; per D01 this does not establish unique composition.

A-O04-O06-SAME.scope: material_response observations O04 and O06, state-0, x_mm=0
A-O04-O06-SAME.statement: O04 at radius 2 um and O06 at radius 90 um report identical channel values [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05], so S17 interior composition is indistinguishable at these two radii within tolerance.

A-O03-PROFILE.statement: Radial profile O03 at x=500 measures contrast 100 units from r=0 to 124.9 um, then 20 units at r=125.1 and 150 um, with no resolved internal step at the sampled radii.

A-O02-O03-SAME.scope: radial_profile observations O02 (x=0) and O03 (x=500), state-0
A-O02-O03-SAME.statement: O02 and O03 report identical contrast values at all sampled radii, so the ~125 um boundary interval is the same at the two measured sections; only two of the 1000 mm length were sampled.

A-O05-VALUES.scope: material_response observation O05, state-0, x_mm=0, radius_um=20
A-O05-VALUES.statement: Material_response O05 at S17 x=0, radius 20 um reports channel values [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] on q1-q5.

A-O05-GLASS-MATCH.scope: comparison of O05 to doc:references@1 glass reference G, state-0
A-O05-GLASS-MATCH.statement: O05 response at S17 x=0, radius 20 um matches material:glass reference G within reported tolerance; per D01 this does not establish unique composition.

A-O04-O05-O06-SAME.scope: material_response observations O04, O05, O06, state-0, x_mm=0
A-O04-O05-O06-SAME.statement: O04 (r=2), O05 (r=20) and O06 (r=90) all report identical channel values [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05], so S17 interior is indistinguishable at these three radii within tolerance.

A-O08-TIMES.statement: pulse_trace O08 records input times [0, 100, 200] ns and output times [5.0, 105.0, 205.0] ns at S17 ports S17:in and S17:out.

A-O08-DELAY.statement: O08 shows a constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay for all three pulses, consistent with a fixed total path, but per D01 the internal path is not observed so no layer structure follows.

A-ERR13-FAIL.statement: A set_temperature attempt (ERROR-13) failed with a protocol error and empty arguments; this is an access failure, not a physical measurement or a material impossibility.

A-ERR14-FAIL.statement: A second attempt (ERROR-14) was rejected as a protocol error with graph_unchanged true, so the O08 pulse_trace assertions were not persisted by that attempt.

A-DREF4-DUP.statement: Reading material:P-B returns record D-REF-4, the same reference entry as D02, and its scope note states it is not a new chemical analysis of S17.

A-PA-PB-NODIFF.scope: material:P-A D-REF-3 and material:P-B D-REF-4 resource reads, state-0
A-PA-PB-NODIFF.statement: Both resource reads return identical D02 entries with response [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2], so the reference library supplies no additional data separating P-A from P-B.

A-C0014-TEMP.scope: intervention record A01, state-0 to state-1
A-C0014-TEMP.statement: set_temperature C0014 changed state-0 to state-1, cell and sample sensors read 40 C, and identity of S17, V04, U09 was preserved.

A-C0015-DUP.scope: material:P-A resource read C0015 at state-1 (40 C), revision 1 payload D-REF-3
A-C0015-DUP.statement: Reading material:P-A at state-1 (40 C) returns the same D-REF-3 entry as at state-0, with reference_conditions 20 C and additional_data null, so the resource supplies no 40 C reference data.

A-O09-TIMES.statement: pulse_trace O09 at state-1 (40 C) records input times [0, 100, 200] ns and output times [5.01, 105.01, 205.01] ns at S17 ports S17:in and S17:out.

A-O09-DELAY-SHIFT.scope: comparison of pulse_trace O08 (state-0, 20 C) and O09 (state-1, 40 C)
A-O09-DELAY-SHIFT.statement: The constant input-to-output delay is 5.0 ns at 20 C and 5.01 ns at 40 C; the 0.01 ns shift is ten times the 0.001 ns clock resolution, so it is a resolved change, but per D01 the internal path is unobserved and no layer structure follows.

A-DREF2-DUP.scope: material:additive resource read C0017 at state-1 (40 C), revision 1 payload D-REF-2
A-DREF2-DUP.statement: Reading material:additive returns record D-REF-2, the same D02 entry with reference_conditions 20 C and additional_data null, so it supplies no 40 C data and is not a new analysis of S17.

A-REF-LIB-NO-CONSTRAINT.scope: resource reads of material:P-A, material:P-B and material:additive, state-0 and state-1
A-REF-LIB-NO-CONSTRAINT.statement: All three resource reads return only their unchanged D02 entries with no additional data, so the open reference library provides no new constraint on S17's coating material.

A-C0018-TEMP.scope: intervention record A02, state-1 to state-2
A-C0018-TEMP.statement: set_temperature C0018 changed state-1 to state-2, cell and sample sensors read 20 C, and identity of S17, V04, U09 was preserved.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

QDOC.text: Какие документы, калибровки или материалы доступны через catalog:root и какие из них относятся к S17?

QMODEL.text: What does doc:model-M7@1 report about model M7 and how, if at all, does it relate to S17's external marking M7?

QMAT.text: What does doc:references@1 report about material P-A responses, and can it constrain S17's coating?

QINSTR.text: Do the reported instrument limits (resolvable step 5 units, tolerance 0.001, non-unique composition) constrain how S17 observations may be interpreted?

QSTRUCT.text: What is S17's internal radial structure, and how does the ~125 um external boundary relate to any coating or core?

QENV.text: What are V04 and U09, and how do temperature and material_response of U09 interact with S17?

QAXIAL.text: Does S17's radial profile vary with axial position x, and is the ~125 um boundary uniform along the length?

QCOATING.text: Is the contrast drop at ~125 um a coating boundary, and can material_response at U09 distinguish the coating material?

QINTERNAL.text: Are there any internal layers below the 5-unit resolvable step that the radial_profile instrument cannot resolve?

QCOMP.text: What does material_response at S17 radii report about internal composition or layers, and does it match any reference material?

QPULSE.text: What do pulse_trace input/output times report for S17, and can they constrain internal path length or layer structure given that the internal path is not observed?

QPULSE-DELAY.text: What effective path or medium does the constant 5.0 ns delay imply, given that the internal pulse path is not observed?

QTEMP.text: What changes in S17, V04 and U09 observations at 40 C (state-1) and after return to 20 C (state-2)?

QCOATING-BOUNDARY.text: Can material_response sample the ~125 um boundary region at all, given that the available radii are 2, 20 and 90 um?

QMAT-TEMP.text: Does material:P-A reference response change at 40 C, and can it constrain S17's coating at state-1?

QPULSE-TEMP.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns pulse_trace input-to-output delay change at 40 C (state-1)?

QPULSE-TEMP-SHIFT.text: Does the resolved 0.01 ns delay increase at 40 C indicate a temperature-dependent path or medium, given that the internal pulse path is not observed?

QPULSE-TEMP-REVERSIBILITY.text: Does the resolved 0.01 ns pulse delay shift at 40 C revert when V04 returns to 20 C (state-2), indicating a reversible temperature-dependent path?
